description: SWARM Read Page - Retrieve the readable text of a web page (menus, scripts and markup removed). Requires `url`; HTML or text up to 3 MB. Not billed if the page cannot be read. $0.002. Calls SWARM's shop over the network and, with SWARM_WALLET_KEY set, pays in USDC on Base via x402 (the live quote is checked against SWARM_MAX_USD before paying; charged only on success).

url.description: Public http(s) URL, ports 80/443 only, e.g. https://example.com

name: read_page
title: Read a web page
